name: Ethiopia
shortSummary: India is a significant development partner for Ethiopia, extending lines of credit for infrastructure and industrial projects, with Ethiopian Airlines and Indian pharmaceutical exports anchoring commercial ties.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Indian lines of credit support Ethiopian industrial and infrastructure projects.
Pan-African e-Network connectivity projects link Indian expertise to Ethiopian institutions.

recentDevelopments.title: Development financing continues
recentDevelopments.description: Indian lines of credit continued supporting Ethiopian industrial and infrastructure projects.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: A steady development partnership largely insulated from Ethiopia's domestic political volatility.

historicalEvents.title: Establishment of Diplomatic Relations
historicalEvents.description: India and Ethiopia establish diplomatic relations shortly after Indian independence.

historicalEvents.title: Pan-African e-Network Project
historicalEvents.description: India extends telemedicine and tele-education connectivity to Ethiopia under the Pan-African e-Network initiative.
